detail.longDescription: Hello, We’re Iki Software, an AI R&D company working on “SPC-AI”, our new AI technology. SPC is a different kind of AI from LLMs, transformers or neural networks. Instead of prompting, you use it as a trainable data-structure inside software. It’s easily trained by common programmers, and has a number of uses we’re eager to talk about. We’re currently looking at our first public release in a few weeks (pending any behind the scenes business stuff), so that everyone can learn about and get their hands on SPC. We’ve got minimal library implementations ready in four languages: Python, JavaScript, C++ and Lua for anyone interested. But to that end, we wanted to ask so we can better prepare: what would you like to see or hear about our SPC-AI that would interest you in about two to three weeks time? We look forward to your replies! Thanks, and have a great day.
